itemListElement.name: Google Meet AI Note Takers Worth Using in India in 2026

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet have a free AI note taker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Meet's Take notes for me needs an eligible Workspace edition or Google AI plan, so it is not free on personal Gmail accounts. Free third-party options include Lynkk, Fathom, Read AI, Otter and Tactiq.

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet's AI note taker support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google's help center lists 8 supported languages: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish. Mixed-language meetings are not supported.

mainEntity.name: How do I add an AI note taker to Google Meet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turn on Take notes for me inside the meeting, connect a bot-based tool like Lynkk or Read AI to your calendar, or install a Chrome extension such as Lynkk's or Tactiq.

mainEntity.name: What is the best Google Meet AI note taker for India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk is a strong fit for Indian teams because it supports Hindi, has a Hinglish setting and offers an India data region. Gemini's own notes suit English-only Workspace teams.

mainEntity.name: Is it legal to use an AI note taker in Google Meet in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using an AI note taker is generally allowed when participants know the meeting is being recorded or transcribed. Under the DPDP Act, be clear about how personal data is processed and stored, and follow your company's policies.

mainEntity.name: Can a Google Meet AI note taker work without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes.
